quote_1: We've got probes for premature stopping and for looping past a finished objective, but no unified way to score them against each other, so right now it's three separate numbers instead of one coherent picture of whether the agent stops at the right moment.
quote_2: ⟦T2⟧ was tallied from the checker-confirmed completion point for the revised objective.
justification: ⟦T2⟧ specifically measures continued actions after confirmed completion, which is one of ⟦T1⟧'s stopping-timing failures. ⟦T1⟧ additionally covers premature stopping and continuing despite corrupted inputs.
